reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is inaccurate. Phase 03 claims that downstream reconstruction code assumes sidecars[i].index == i, but the actual code at kzg_utils.rs:372 explicitly sorts data columns by index before processing: `data_columns.sort_unstable_by_key(|dc| dc.index)`. The reconstruction loop at line 396 uses `data_column.index` directly (from the sorted array), not array position. Therefore, even if an attacker sends sidecars with swapped positional indices, the sort operation will reorder them correctly before KZG operations. The spec invariant INV-001 ('All cells in a column share the same cell index') is enforced by design through the sort. Attack path is blocked by defensive sorting pattern.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: SG-003 (verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs) INV-001 requires all cells in a column share the same cell index. The code enforces this through sorting at kzg_utils.rs:372 before reconstruction.
